seasonal_note: Seasonal context: November and early December reflect pre-Christmas wholesale giftware stocking, which lifts weekly revenue and order volume well above early-autumn baselines.

show_work.definition: Gross revenue minus the value of cancelled (returned) lines.
show_work.caveats: Returns are booked in the week of the cancellation invoice, not the week of the original sale.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14'

show_work.caveats: One invoice can contain several categories, so orders by category do not add up to total orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14'

show_work.definition: Gross revenue divided by the number of orders.
show_work.caveats: With a category filter this is category revenue per order that contains the category.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14'

show_work.definition: Number of distinct identified customers with at least one sale in the period.
show_work.caveats: Guest orders have no customer ID and are not counted.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14'

show_work.definition: Share of identified customers in the period whose order was not their first order in this dataset.
show_work.caveats: The data starts in December 2009, so customers who bought before then look new. Early months understate this rate and inflate "new" customers.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND customer_type = 'returning' THEN customer_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14'

show_work.definition: Returns divided by gross revenue, by value.
show_work.caveats: Returns and sales in the same period are not necessarily the same orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT -SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14'

drivers.total_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS current, SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-31' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-07' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS previous, COUNT(*) AS rows_scanned FROM lines WHERE ((invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14') OR (invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-31' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-07'))

summary.text: For the week of 2011-11-07, net revenue reached £350,123, representing a strong week-over-week increase of +21.4% compared to £288,344 the previous week. This performance was also exceptionally positive when compared against the prior 4-week average of £246,463, surging by +42.1%. Operational volume saw significant growth with 634 total orders placed, which was well above the 8-week median of 456, while the average order value rose to £564.21, reflecting a +1.6% change week-over-week and a +7.0% increase against the prior 4-week average of £527.43. The primary top-level drivers fueling this weekly momentum were the Bags product category and sales originating from the United Kingdom, which stood at £316,789.19. Overall, the business experienced healthy gains across key customer and transactional metrics during the period.
